name: Combine 2D T2w images into a single 3D volume - 2 orientations
summary: Reconstructs a single high-resolution 3D T2-weighted volume from 2 stacks of 2D T2-weighted slices (axial and coronal) using NiftyMIC super-resolution volume reconstruction.
description: Runs niftymic_reconstruct_volume (NiftyMIC) on 2 T2-weighted slice stacks acquired in different orientations (axial and coronal) and combines them into one motion-corrected 3D volume. Use it when only thick-slice 2D acquisitions are available and a single isotropic-like volume is needed for further analysis. All stacks must belong to the same subject and session; intermediate files (motion-correction transforms, masks, NiftyMIC configs) are kept in a separate raw output.

inputs.description: Stack of 2D T2-weighted slices acquired in the axial orientation.
Stack of 2D T2-weighted slices acquired in the coronal orientation.

outputs.description: NiftyMIC intermediate files: motion-correction folder, stack masks and the config JSON files.

parameters.description: Base name of the reconstructed output file (written as <type>.nii.gz); should match the output datatype (t1 or t2).

failure_modes.cause: niftymic_reconstruct_volume did not produce the reconstructed volume.
failure_modes.fix: Check the job log for the NiftyMIC error; make sure all inputs are slice stacks of the same subject.
